summary: Your database stays lean, duplicate assets disappear, and you can open SecurityInsight straight from Invardia.

new.title: Open SecurityInsight from the Invardia portal
new.text: The Invardia overview and every support mail about your install now carry an "Open SecurityInsight" link.

new.title: Documentation for your version in the portal
new.text: The Invardia portal and invardia.com now show the install options, the reference and the release notes for the version you run.

fixes.title: Database no longer grows between busy runs
fixes.text: Old finding data is now removed while a run is going, paced by the database's load, so installs with back-to-back runs clean up too.

fixes.title: Duplicate asset records are merged at once
fixes.text: An asset stored twice is now merged at once, also in what goes to ServiceNow. A new install's first run no longer creates such copies.

fixes.title: Brief database interruptions no longer fail a run
fixes.text: When the database is briefly unavailable, the work is sent again where that is safe, instead of failing the step.

fixes.title: Pro install waits for its licence
fixes.text: A Pro install without its licence now waits for it instead of stopping with an error. The licence then arrives through the update.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A full database is reported as its own cause, failed steps name their error, the web app's key check no longer reports a problem that is not there, and setup status reaches Invardia.
